note: L4 terminal devices add no native build and no new npm dependency: pure Node over a vetted system audio binary. G-NATIVE evidence below pins the helper binaries, the zero-dependency posture, the device-listing trace and the explicitly blocked paths.

toolchain.nodeGyp: never invoked in live-speech install, build, test or device paths
toolchain.nativeBuild: none — no native module in the L4 path; faster-whisper-ts stays an optional L3 peer

packageDependencies.note: Zero runtime dependencies: capture/device/control import only node:child_process and node builtins.

arecord.license: GPL-2 (separate native executable, subprocess aggregation — same treatment as the L3 eSpeak NG binary)
arecord.invocation: arecord -D <id> -f S16_LE -r <rate> -c 1 -t raw (explicit argv, shell:false; stdout streamed as PCM, stderr drained as text, no audio files)

pw-record.license: package mix Expat/LGPL-2.1+ (see /usr/share/doc/pipewire-bin/copyright); subprocess aggregation only

deviceTrace.note: Listing only: proves backend parsing against real hardware enumeration. No capture attempted — no microphone in this environment, and microphone capture is forbidden in CI tests (FakeDevice covers behavior).

networkPosture.runtimeDownloads: none — audio helpers are preinstalled system binaries, not fetched artifacts; no npm audio dependency added
networkPosture.audioInTests: synthetic PCM only via FakeDevice; no audio payload in events or logs (counts, revisions, ids and text only)

sbom.delta: empty — L4 adds zero packages to package.json/package-lock.json; SBOM is the unchanged L3 set plus two system binaries pinned above

liveMicCapture.detail: No microphone available on the host or CI runners; live capture stays undelivered. Path: FakeDevice behavior + qualified arecord backend + device-listing trace.

speakerAEC.detail: Speaker mode needs an output reference (spec §5.1), not just an amplitude threshold. Headset-only profile until a qualified AEC reference exists; speaker mode stays unavailable, never silently muted.

holdToTalk.detail: No qualified native hotkey or browser companion source in this lot, so TerminalController push mode fails closed (ControlError). Toggle and explicit start/end keys only.
